features.feature: First real-host unattended runner path for Claude Code CLI via policy-bound dispatch_auto
v1.0.1 is Claude Code only; Gemini and Codex remain scaffolded or refused
Real subprocess launch requires explicit allowRealHostSubprocess policy opt-in; allowedHosts alone is insufficient

Policy gate validates allowed host, allowed and denied paths, command allowlist, runtime timeout, network and budget posture, env filtering, requireReceipt, requireReview, no auto-merge, and no productionDone
host_runtime_probe remains diagnostic and conservative; host availability does not authorize real subprocess execution by itself
Claude runner launches from an isolated dispatch worktree with a bounded prompt file, filtered environment, policy timeout, and stdout/stderr transcript capture
Runner metadata and status expose runnerKind=claude-code-real, cwd, transcriptPath, exitCode, timedOut, and safe non-zero or timeout status mapping
dispatch_status, dispatch_watch, and dispatch_review surface real runner summary, changed files, transcript presence, command output, risks, and manual next action
dispatch_cancel can terminate or mark real-runner dispatches cancelled while preserving transcript, metadata, and worktree evidence
dispatch_collect, dispatch_review, and dispatch_merge_plan keep evidence-only and manual boundaries including manualOnly=true, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, and authorityChanged=false
Local transcripts and diagnostic receipts never become production authority, verified receipts, auto-merge, or auto-DONE evidence
Unattended dispatch preserves existing lease, conflict, scope review, and story ownership constraints for mutating work
Deterministic fake claude smoke covers success, non-zero exit, timeout, missing opt-in, unsafe env, out-of-policy command, scope failure, and authority invariants
Tiny live Claude Code canary is attempted only after deterministic tests and is classified successful, unavailable, or blocked without weakening deterministic coverage
Real subprocess execution for Gemini, Codex, or all real hosts at once
features.excluded_by: decision_get chose policy-bound-claude-real-runner and rejects all-real-hosts-at-once for this story

features.feature: Receipt-backed enforce-mode authority implementation, actor keys, job claims, envelope signing, or AuthorityReceipt verification
features.excluded_by: authority-client-role defers receipt-backed/enforce runner work to separate approved milestones; B-8a1a keeps authority fields false

features.feature: parallel_dispatch or host-neutral console auto-spawn behavior
features.excluded_by: parallel wave and observability console decisions keep parallel_dispatch spawned=false and read-only; B-8a1a is scoped to dispatch_auto only
